+# vim: ft=python fileencoding=utf-8 sts=4 sw=4 et:
+
+"""Tests for the end-to-end JS header marker."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+import conftest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('webengine, qt_version, skipped', [
+    (True, (5, 11), False),
+    (True, (5, 12), True),
+    (True, (5, 14), True),
+    (True, (5, 15), False),
+    (False, (5, 12), False),
+])
+def test_js_headers_marker(monkeypatch, webengine, qt_version, skipped):
+    def version_check(version, compiled=False):
+        return qt_version >= tuple(int(part) for part in version.split('.'))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(conftest.qtutils, 'version_check', version_check)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(webengine=webengine)
+    item = mock.Mock()
+    item.get_closest_marker.side_effect = (
+        lambda name: pytest.mark.js_headers.mark if name == 'js_headers'
+        else None)
+
+    conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, [item])
+
+    if skipped:
+        marker = item.add_marker.call_args[0][0].mark
+        assert marker.name == 'skipif'
+        assert marker.args[0]
+    else:
+        item.add_marker.assert_not_called()
